decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical DBCS build-switch notice.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
dossym.inc includes dbcs.sw; the frozen dependency inventory records the include in the reference component dependency chains.
The file itself does not define DBCS or emit object bytes: during assembler pass one it prints a notice only if the build already defines DBCS.
The selected kernel reference build report records USA configuration; no DBCS notice was found in its saved logs or listings.
limitations: Absence of a notice in saved output is not proof of all assembler command-line settings. DBCS-conditioned code elsewhere and final English target equality require verification in the complete builds.
